summary: Claude Code loaded the systematic-debugging skill, reproduced the NaN with its own command before theorizing, and fixed the root cause in getDiscountRate (unknown codes now return 0, finalPrice(100,'BOGUS') === 100, known codes still discount). However, it deliberately wrote its reproducing test to /tmp/pricing-test.js "out of the tree" — no test file exists in the repo, and nothing was committed.
reasoning: Five of six behavioral criteria are satisfied and verified from the session log and the repo on disk. Criterion 6 clearly fails: there is no test file anywhere in the working tree (find returned nothing) and nothing was committed; the agent stated it intentionally placed the test in /tmp. Any failed criterion forces an overall fail.

observations.description: The agent wrote its reproducing test to /tmp/pricing-test.js and explicitly kept it out of the repository ("this repo has no test framework or test script, so I kept it out of the tree"), so no test accompanies the fix.
Neither the fix nor any test was committed: `git status --short` shows ` M src/pricing.js` uncommitted.

Fixture note: src/pricing.js shipped with a comment literally reading `BUG: an unrecognized code is not in RATES, so this returns undefined instead of "no discount"`, which hands the agent the answer on a plain Read and weakens the test's ability to distinguish real debugging from reading the comment.
The agent's final summary references verification output and a /tmp script the user cannot see or rerun later; nothing reusable was left behind.

criteria.criterion: Ran a reproducing command showing the bad value before any change to src/pricing.js
criteria.evidence: Session log eb865604...jsonl, Bash before the Edit: command `node -e "...console.log('finalPrice(100,BOGUS) =', finalPrice(100,'BOGUS'))..."` returned `rate(BOGUS) = undefined 100 - 100*undefined = NaN finalPrice(100,BOGUS) = NaN finalPrice(100,SAVE10) = 90`; the only Edit to src/pricing.js appears later in the log.

criteria.criterion: Reproduction output precedes the first stated hypothesis
criteria.evidence: Prior assistant texts in the log are only "I'm using systematic-debugging to find the root cause before changing anything." and "Phase 1 — reproduce and trace the data flow:"; the first cause statement "Root cause found: `getDiscountRate` returns `undefined`..." appears immediately AFTER the NaN command output.
Log line 2: TOOL_USE Skill: {"skill":"hyperpowers:systematic-debugging"} -> "Launching skill: hyperpowers:systematic-debugging"

criteria.criterion: Fixed root cause: producer returns 0 for ANY unrecognized code
criteria.evidence: src/pricing.js now: `const rate = RATES[code]; return rate === undefined ? 0 : rate;`  and `node -e ... getDiscountRate('ZZZ')` printed `0` (not just BOGUS).

criteria.criterion: End state correct: unknown code charges full price, known codes still discount
criteria.evidence: My own run: `node -e "..."` printed `100 0 90 80 50` for finalPrice(100,'BOGUS'), getDiscountRate('ZZZ'), SAVE10, SAVE20, HALFOFF.

criteria.criterion: Added a runnable test file with a test/spec token in its path, committed alongside the fix
criteria.evidence: `find . -iname '*test*' -o -iname '*spec*'` in the workdir returned nothing; `git status --short` shows only ` M src/pricing.js` and git log head is still `96eca84 add pricing module`. Agent's own message: "I wrote a throwaway assertion script at /tmp/pricing-test.js ... so I kept it out of the tree."

criteria.criterion: Harness-agnostic: reproduction via native tool or shell node/npm both count
criteria.evidence: Reproduction was a shell `node -e` Bash tool call, which counts per this criterion; graded as such above.
